name: Full-page profile editor with the Voice section
description:
Add a full-page profile editor at route `/:projectName/profiles/:name/edit` because `client/src/components/team-view/TeamMemberDrawer.vue` (32rem panel) is too narrow for the voice settings the user asked for. Mobile-first: single column at 360px, two columns from `lg`, sticky save bar, every control >=44px, no horizontal scrolling.

The Voice section leads with the RESOLVED voice, then offers the override:
1. On mount call the resolve endpoint implemented in `api/codx/junior/api/profile_voice.py` (READ THAT FILE for the exact path prefix and response shape; it is `GET .../profiles/{name}/voice`). Render the resolved voice and its `source` in one sentence, e.g. "This profile will sound like Kokoro af_bella — inherited from project" / "— own voice" / "— system default" / "this profile never speaks in videos".
2. Then the override form: enabled toggle, provider, voice_id, model, speed slider, language, style. Persist through the SAME profile write endpoint that `TeamMemberDrawer.vue` already uses (the profiles API accepts a `voice` object; `profile_management` was extended to accept it) — do NOT invent a new write endpoint.
3. A "Preview" button calls `POST .../profiles/{name}/voice/preview`. That endpoint answers **503 with a reason** when no TTS engine is installed. Show that reason inline in the section ("no TTS engine installed yet — voice will be rendered once a voice provider is available"). Never fake audio, never turn it into a generic error toast.

Keep `TeamMemberDrawer.vue` fully working; add an "open full editor" link to it and do NOT widen the drawer.

TIME BUDGET: write `ProfileEditorView.vue` first (that is the deliverable), then the router entry, then compile. At most ~8 tool calls before the first write. Never run pytest or any python command: the python module imports in this repo take >10 minutes and they killed two earlier steps in this run.

**Acceptance criteria**
`npm run build-only --prefix client` exits 0 (run it in the codx-junior-default-workspace container, which has node; the codx-junior-client container has none) and the editor route is registered in `client/src/router/index.ts`. The Voice section renders the resolved voice + `source` from the API, exposes the override fields, and a 503 from the preview endpoint is displayed as a readable inline message (verify by reading the code path; a browser is not required). `TeamMemberDrawer.vue` still compiles and keeps its existing behaviour. Only the editor's own files plus the router and the drawer link are touched.

# ORCHESTRATED STEP
Run: **Project's Channel — M0 spine**
Step: **Full-page profile editor with the Voice section** (`profile-editor`)

## Run objective
Build the load-bearing spine for the "Project's Channel" feature described in `design/project-channel.md` (read it first; it is the contract).

Scope of M0 only:
1. New python package `api/codx/junior/media/` with models (MediaJob, MediaAsset, EpisodeIR, RenderSpec, VoiceProfile, ProviderInfo), a `MediaProvider` protocol + registry, a job store under `<project>/.codx/media/` (inbox/jobs/episodes/assets), a cost/estimate budget gate, and a mandatory redaction entry point. Pure python, no network, unit-tested.
2. A background worker `media/worker.py` exposing `start_media_worker(stop_event)` / `stop_media_worker()` wired into `api/codx/junior/background.py` exactly like the existing wiki scheduler / orchestration worker (lazy import inside try/except, symmetric stop). Jobs must be persisted with leases + retries so a restart resumes work.
3. A FastAPI router `api/codx/junior/api/media.py` exposing `/api/media/providers`, `/api/media/queue`, `/api/media/episodes` (create/detail), `/api/media/assets/...`, following the conventions in `api/codx/junior/api/wiki.py`.
4. A local image provider PoC able to produce an episode cover with content-addressed caching (hash of provider+model+prompt+spec); ComfyUI is the real target but the provider must degrade to an available local/offline path when ComfyUI is not running.
5. Client shell: `/channel` view with tabs Home, Library (reusing `client/src/components/wiki/WikiMarkdown.vue` + `client/src/service/wiki.js`), Episodes, Shorts, Learn. The existing wiki nav entry becomes a tab inside the channel; existing `/wiki` routes must keep resolving.

Hard constraints:
- No external AI/media services in this milestone; local-first only.
- Do not break existing wiki behaviour or the existing background services.
- Keep changes reviewable; no reformatting of untouched code.
- Every new module gets tests where it is testable offline.

## Step objective
Add a full-page profile editor at route `/:projectName/profiles/:name/edit` because `client/src/components/team-view/TeamMemberDrawer.vue` (32rem panel) is too narrow for the voice settings the user asked for. Mobile-first: single column at 360px, two columns from `lg`, sticky save bar, every control >=44px, no horizontal scrolling.

The Voice section leads with the RESOLVED voice, then offers the override:
1. On mount call the resolve endpoint implemented in `api/codx/junior/api/profile_voice.py` (READ THAT FILE for the exact path prefix and response shape; it is `GET .../profiles/{name}/voice`). Render the resolved voice and its `source` in one sentence, e.g. "This profile will sound like Kokoro af_bella — inherited from project" / "— own voice" / "— system default" / "this profile never speaks in videos".
2. Then the override form: enabled toggle, provider, voice_id, model, speed slider, language, style. Persist through the SAME profile write endpoint that `TeamMemberDrawer.vue` already uses (the profiles API accepts a `voice` object; `profile_management` was extended to accept it) — do NOT invent a new write endpoint.
3. A "Preview" button calls `POST .../profiles/{name}/voice/preview`. That endpoint answers **503 with a reason** when no TTS engine is installed. Show that reason inline in the section ("no TTS engine installed yet — voice will be rendered once a voice provider is available"). Never fake audio, never turn it into a generic error toast.

Keep `TeamMemberDrawer.vue` fully working; add an "open full editor" link to it and do NOT widen the drawer.

TIME BUDGET: write `ProfileEditorView.vue` first (that is the deliverable), then the router entry, then compile. At most ~8 tool calls before the first write. Never run pytest or any python command: the python module imports in this repo take >10 minutes and they killed two earlier steps in this run.

## Acceptance criteria
`npm run build-only --prefix client` exits 0 (run it in the codx-junior-default-workspace container, which has node; the codx-junior-client container has none) and the editor route is registered in `client/src/router/index.ts`. The Voice section renders the resolved voice + `source` from the API, exposes the override fields, and a 503 from the preview endpoint is displayed as a readable inline message (verify by reading the code path; a browser is not required). `TeamMemberDrawer.vue` still compiles and keeps its existing behaviour. Only the editor's own files plus the router and the drawer link are touched.

## Known files
- `client/src/views/ProfileEditorView.vue`
- `client/src/router/index.ts`
- `client/src/components/team-view/TeamMemberDrawer.vue`
- `api/codx/junior/api/profile_voice.py`

- Work only on this step; do not start unrelated refactors.
- Inspect the code before changing it and keep the change reviewable.
- Verify your work (tests, build, manual check) and say how.
- If you are blocked, explain exactly what is missing instead of guessing forever.
- Do not burn your tool budget: batch the reads you need and re-use the results already in the conversation. Only stop for a tool limit if you have run out of continuations, and then report what you already know.

"""Pydantic models for the Project's Channel media pipeline.

Pure data definitions: only stdlib + pydantic, no I/O and no imports from
other codx.junior packages, so this module stays importable from the
store, the worker, the API router and the tests alike.
"""

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Literal, Optional

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field


def utc_now() -> datetime:
    """Timezone aware timestamp used as default for every ``created_at``."""
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)


# Capabilities a provider can declare
ProviderCapability = Literal["image", "voice", "video", "capture", "assemble"]
# Asset kinds stored under .codx/media/assets
MediaKind = Literal["image", "audio", "video", "caption", "doc"]
# Render formats
MediaFormat = Literal["16:9", "9:16"]
# Shot kinds inside an episode ir
ShotKind = Literal["slide", "replay", "still", "title", "transcript"]
# Job kinds
JobKind = Literal["episode", "short", "cover", "revoice"]
# Job lifecycle
JobState = Literal["queued", "leased", "running", "done", "failed", "rejected"]


class ProviderInfo(BaseModel):
    """Description of a media provider and of its current availability."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="allow")

    name: str = Field(description="Provider identifier, e.g. 'comfyui', 'piper'")
    capability: ProviderCapability = Field(
        description="What the provider produces: image, voice, video, capture or assemble"
    )
    available: bool = Field(default=False, description="Provider reachable right now")
    local: bool = Field(default=True, description="Runs on this machine / offline")
    model: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="Model or checkpoint used")
    reason: Optional[str] = Field(
        default=None, description="Why the provider is unavailable, when it is"
    )
    cost_per_unit: float = Field(
        default=0.0, description="Cost per unit produced, 0 means free/local"
    )


class MediaAsset(BaseModel):
    """A produced artifact, addressed by content hash and stored in the project."""

    asset_id: str = Field(default="", description="Stable asset identifier")
    kind: MediaKind = Field(default="doc", description="Asset kind")
    path: str = Field(default="", description="Project relative path of the asset")
    sha256: str = Field(default="", description="Content hash used for caching")
    mime: str = Field(default="application/octet-stream")
    bytes: int = Field(default=0, description="Asset size in bytes")
    provider: str = Field(default="", description="Provider that produced the asset")
    model: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="Provider model")
    created_at: datetime = Field(default_factory=utc_now)


class RenderSpec(BaseModel):
    """How an episode/short is rendered."""

    format: MediaFormat = Field(default="16:9")
    width: int = Field(default=1920)
    height: int = Field(default=1080)
    fps: int = Field(default=30)
    loudness_target: float = Field(
        default=-16.0, description="Integrated loudness target in LUFS"
    )
    captions: bool = Field(default=True, description="Generate a caption track")
    burned_captions: bool = Field(
        default=False, description="Burn captions into the video"
    )


class VoiceProfile(BaseModel):
    """Voice used for narration; snapshotted into the episode ir."""

    enabled: bool = Field(default=True)
    provider: str = Field(default="")
    voice_id: str = Field(default="")
    model: Optional[str] = Field(default=None)
    speed: float = Field(default=1.0)
    style: Optional[str] = Field(default=None)
    language: Optional[str] = Field(default=None)
    reference_asset: Optional[str] = Field(
        default=None, description="Asset id used as voice reference (cloning)"
    )


class Shot(BaseModel):
    """One unit of the episode timeline."""
